route: UEFI -> existing Fedora shim -> Linux EFI stub -> tested host-only initramfs -> same Monet deployment
reason_for_shim: Current TPM disk-unlock token is bound to SHA256 PCR 7. The measured boot log includes shim's SbatLevel EV_EFI_VARIABLE_AUTHORITY event in PCR 7. Omitting shim would change that measurement. No TPM enrollment or encryption settings were changed.
preparation_note: Initial unarmed attempt caught efibootmgr 18 omitting the UTF-16 terminator with --unicode. That entry and its files were removed with original state verified. The installed attempt supplies an exact terminated binary payload with --append-binary-args.
limitations: The trial booted the intended EFI kernel and deployment. User-reported time to the desktop and the systemd total have different endpoints. This bypasses GRUB, not shim or Lenovo firmware. BootNext was one-time; the original boot order remains unchanged. This is not an update-aware permanent boot installation.
